name: nexus-agent-os
description: Local Multi-Agent Desktop OS with full Windows laptop access, real-time agent collaboration, and granular safety controls.

scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n SERVER,UI -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,UI,DESKTOP -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/health http://127.0.0.1:5178 && cross-env NEXUS_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5178 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
